trial_title: Effect of Intraventricular tPA Following Aneurysmal Subarachnoid Hemorrhage
brief_summary: This study will evaluate the hypothesis that the administration of intraventricular tPA reduces the rates of cerebral vasospasm and ventriculoperitoneal shunt-dependent hydrocephalus in patients with aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage.

eligibility_table.criterion: SAH due to aneurysm, as determined by CT angiogram or cerebral angiogram.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has spontaneous intraventricular hemorrhage due to arteriovenous malformation (AVM), not due to an aneurysm.

eligibility_table.criterion: Modified Fisher (mF) grade 3 or 4 SAH, defined as thick cisternal blood without (grade 3) or with (grade 4) intraventricular blood.
eligibility_table.justification: The modified Fisher grade is not specified in the profile; further imaging would be needed to determine this.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a modified Fisher grade of 3 or 4 based on the presence of thick cisternal blood and/or intraventricular blood?

eligibility_table.criterion: Exclusion of the aneurysm from the parent circulation by endovascular embolization (Raymond class I or II) within 48 hours of ictus.
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information regarding endovascular embolization or the status of any aneurysm.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient undergone endovascular embolization of the aneurysm resulting in Raymond class I or II within 48 hours of ictus?

eligibility_table.criterion: Ventriculostomy placement must occur prior to randomization.
eligibility_table.justification: The profile does not mention whether a ventriculostomy has been placed.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient undergone ventriculostomy placement prior to randomization?

eligibility_table.criterion: Informed consent obtained from the patient or patient's decision maker.
eligibility_table.justification: Assuming informed consent can be obtained from the patient or decision maker.

eligibility_table.criterion: Determination by treating physician(s) that no ventriculostomy is needed.
eligibility_table.justification: The treating physician's determination regarding the need for ventriculostomy is not provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the treating physician determine that the patient's intracranial pressure is stable and does not require a ventriculostomy based on current clinical assessment?

eligibility_table.criterion: Presence of intrinsic clotting disorders (e.g. due to hepatic failure, nephrotic syndrome, etc). Subjects whose pharmacologic anticoagulation is reversed, as determined by PT/INR, PTT within our institution's normal range, will be permitted to participate in this study.
eligibility_table.justification: No information is provided regarding intrinsic clotting disorders or anticoagulation status.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient's PT/INR and PTT within the institution's normal range?

eligibility_table.criterion: Presence of significant anemia, defined as hemoglobin < 8 gm/dL.
eligibility_table.justification: No lab values in patient profile
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient's hemoglobin level currently < 8 gm/dL?

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients who undergo endovascular techniques requiring post-operative dual anti-platelet therapy.
eligibility_table.justification: The profile does not indicate whether the patient underwent endovascular techniques requiring dual anti-platelet therapy.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient undergone any endovascular techniques that require post-operative dual anti-platelet therapy?

eligibility_table.criterion: Residual aneurysm sac filling (Raymond class III occlusion).
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information on the status of any residual aneurysm sac filling.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the residual aneurysm sac filling classified as Raymond class III occlusion on the latest imaging study?

eligibility_table.criterion: Aneurysm or vessel perforation during the endovascular procedure.
eligibility_table.justification: The profile does not mention any complications such as aneurysm or vessel perforation during procedures.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Did the endovascular procedure result in any visible aneurysm or vessel perforation as confirmed by post-procedure imaging?

eligibility_table.justification: The patient profile does not mention a craniectomy, but it is unclear if any surgical intervention has occurred.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient undergone a craniectomy procedure since the diagnosis of aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage?

eligibility_table.criterion: Significant neurologic disability prior to the onset of SAH.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a significant medical history but does not explicitly state the level of neurologic disability prior to the hemorrhage.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a modified Rankin Scale score of ≥3 prior to the onset of subarachnoid hemorrhage?

eligibility_table.criterion: Determination that administration of tPA/placebo cannot be initiated within 72 hours of symptom onset.
eligibility_table.justification: The onset of symptoms is not specified, making it impossible to determine if tPA/placebo can be administered within the required timeframe.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced symptom onset from the aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage for more than 72 hours?

eligibility_table.criterion: Presence of untreated intracranial aneurysms larger than 3mm on CT angiography or cerebral angiogram.
eligibility_table.justification: No lab values in patient profile
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have any untreated intracranial aneurysms larger than 3mm as identified on CT angiography or cerebral angiogram?
